items.label: Feirongda investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (10-08-2026)
items.signal_prefix: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: for embodied-AI robots it mainly supplies

set.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: for embodied-AI robots it mainly supplies thermal materials, fans, liquid-cooling systems, lightweight structural parts, joint modules, dexterous hands and embodied robots. Its controlled subsidiary Guoli Intelligent focuses on biomimetic dexterous hands and dexterous manipulation; the hands' force-control and motion-control solutions are all self-developed and use tactile, proprioceptive and soft intelligent sensing units, position sensing units and temperature sensors for multimodal perception, led by its R&D department. The related products are at sample, test or small-batch supply stages with several customers, and the business is still a small share of company revenue.

items.reason: The company's answer names the subsidiary only as 'Guoli Intelligent' (short name); the full legal name 'Shenzhen Guoli Intelligent Technology' appears only in the investor's question (context only, never captured). Rest of the entry matches the answers.
